topics.name: Process Scheduling
topics.summary: Determines the order in which processes get CPU time. Key algorithms (FCFS, SJF, RR, Priority) are frequently tested through Gantt chart numericals.
topics.strategy: Memorize all scheduling algorithms with Gantt chart examples and compare criteria like CPU utilization, throughput, and waiting time.
key_points: FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, Priority Scheduling
Scheduling criteria: CPU utilization, throughput, turnaround time

topics.name: Process Synchronization, Critical Section & Deadlocks
topics.summary: Covers safe access to shared resources via synchronization tools, and deadlock situations where processes are indefinitely blocked. Both are heavily tested with theory and numericals.
topics.strategy: Understand critical section requirements and semaphore operations, then practice Banker's Algorithm and Resource Allocation Graphs for deadlock numericals.
key_points: Race condition and critical section problem
Classic problems: Producer-Consumer, Readers-Writers, Dining Philosophers
Necessary conditions: Mutual Exclusion, Hold & Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait
Deadlock Prevention vs Avoidance vs Detection

topics.name: Memory Management: Paging, Segmentation & Swapping
topics.summary: Covers all non-virtual memory management techniques including paging, segmentation, and swapping. Address translation, TLB, and allocation strategies are core exam topics.
topics.strategy: Practice logical-to-physical address translation problems, understand TLB role, and review swapping and allocation strategies as supporting concepts.
key_points: Contiguous Memory Allocation: First Fit, Best Fit, Worst Fit
Contiguous allocation: Fixed and Variable partitions

topics.name: Virtual Memory & Page Replacement
topics.summary: Allows processes to run without being fully loaded in memory using demand paging. Page replacement algorithms and thrashing are heavily tested numerically.
topics.strategy: Solve numerical problems on FIFO, LRU, and Optimal page replacement and understand Belady's anomaly.
key_points: FIFO, Optimal, LRU, LRU Approximation algorithms

topics.name: Multithreading & Multithreaded Programming
topics.summary: Threads are lightweight units of CPU execution within a process. Threading models and benefits over single-threaded processes are key exam concepts.
topics.strategy: Focus on threading models (many-to-one, one-to-one, many-to-many) and benefits of multithreading over multiprocessing.
key_points: Benefits: Responsiveness, Resource Sharing, Economy, Scalability

topics.name: OS Structure, System Calls, Process Concept & IPC
topics.summary: Covers OS organization, user-kernel interaction via system calls, process lifecycle, and IPC mechanisms. These foundational topics appear frequently in short-answer questions.
topics.strategy: Know OS structure models, types of system calls, process states with diagrams, and IPC mechanisms for short and descriptive questions.
key_points: Types of System Calls: Process, File, Device, Info, Communication
Process states: New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated
IPC: Shared Memory vs Message Passing

topics.name: File System & File System Implementation
topics.summary: Defines how files are stored, organized, and accessed on disk. Allocation methods and free space management are frequently asked in exams.
topics.strategy: Understand file allocation methods with diagrams and compare directory structures for exam questions.
key_points: Directory Implementation: Linear list, Hash table
Free Space Management: Bit vector, Linked list
File attributes, access methods, and protection

topics.name: Disk Scheduling & System Protection
topics.summary: Disk scheduling optimizes I/O request order to minimize head movement; system protection controls resource access via domains and access matrices.
topics.strategy: Practice disk scheduling numericals for head movement calculation and focus on the Access Matrix model and domain-based protection for theory questions.
key_points: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK
Seek time, Rotational latency, Transfer time
Implementation: Access Control Lists, Capability Lists
